title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
title_zh: Thinking Before Thinking: 通过元推理扩展自主推理的规模

paragraphs.en: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning , an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体处理的问题变得越来越长和复杂，控制执行过程本身也成了一项独立的任务。 每次运行都会带来新的控制决策，例如该基于哪些部分成果继续构建、是否从头开始，以及何时停止。 我们提出了“智能体元推理”——一种推理时的控制框架，它将这些决策转化为一个明确且结构化的推理过程。 执行单元负责完成任务层面的计算，而控制器则整合运行过程中已确立的成果，探索后续选项，评估每个选项在剩余预算下的价值，并基于持久化记忆中的上下文信息调度选定的工作。 在两次决策之间，控制器仅携带运行的简要摘要，而非重播其完整历史。 我们的基线模型涵盖了生产级编码智能体和研究框架，以及一个使用相同执行单元和计算预算限额的直接控制智能体。 在通过程序重构测试长期智能体能力的 ProgramBench 上，元推理在 GPT-5.5 上的准确率为 71.5%，而 Codex 为 58.0%；在 Opus 4.8 上，其准确率为 67.2%，而 Claude Code 为 65.5%。 在其他涵盖抽象推理、多领域长期推理和证明生成的基准测试中，与直接控制相比，它在三种前沿模型上的平均得分提升了 3.6 至 4.2 分。 在直接控制性能趋于平缓的预算范围内，元推理持续提升，尽管在小预算下其额外开销可能会产生负面影响。 产物图分析显示，早期成果被更频繁地复用，大多数场景下正确解决方案的覆盖范围更高，且最终选择的提升效果并不均匀。 这些结果表明，随着智能体处理运行时间越来越长，将计算资源投入结构化控制的重要性会显著提升。

paragraphs.en: Language model agents increasingly spend a large number of model calls on a single problem, and a considerable share of those calls are decisions about what to do next. Consider a math agent working on a proof, holding a candidate whose main argument looks sound but whose central lemma is unverified. It can attempt the lemma, ask a second worker to check the argument it already has, or abandon the approach for a different one. Each option costs more computation, and those spent on the wrong choice may be wasted. For an agent working autonomously toward a goal, this choice is part of solving the problem, and a capability distinct from producing the next step of the proof.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体在解决单个问题时，越来越多地消耗大量模型调用，而这些调用中相当一部分是用于决定下一步该做什么。 假设一个数学智能体正在处理一个证明问题，它掌握了一个候选方案：其主要论证看似合理，但核心引理尚未得到验证。 它可以尝试验证这个引理，请求第二个工作者检查已有的论证，或者放弃当前方法，转而采用其他方法。 每个选项都会消耗更多计算资源，而用于错误选择的计算资源可能白白浪费。 对于一个自主追求目标的智能体而言，这种选择是解决问题的一部分，是一种独立于生成证明下一步操作的能力。

paragraphs.en: This is a problem of metacognitive control : assessing one’s own progress and using that assessment to decide what to do next ( De Sabbata et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In a single model call, the object of that control is the chain of thought. In an agent it is the work the run has already produced, so it must decide which results to trust, what to build on, and when to stop ( Li et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) . A mistaken judgment costs more than the compute it consumes. It can keep a failed approach alive for the rest of the run, or throw away a correct answer the agent has already found ( Brown et al., 2024 ) . Existing agents often interleave these decisions with the object-level work, taking each control decision in a single step conditioned on their accumulating history ( Yao et al., 2023b ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Shen et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . In this paper we argue that these decisions deserve an agentic reasoning process of their own. An agent can deliberate and inquire before it commits, reading back an earlier result or asking a worker to check one. That deliberation has a structure of its own, consolidating what the run has established, exploring what could be done next, and assessing what each option is worth.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个元认知控制问题：评估自身进展，并利用这一评估来决定下一步该做什么（De Sabbata 等，2024；Liu 等，2026）。 在单次模型调用中，这种控制的对象是思维链。 对于智能体而言，其对象是运行已经产生的成果，因此它必须决定信任哪些结果、基于哪些结果继续推进，以及何时停止（Li 等，2025；Xiang 等，2026）。 错误的判断所造成的代价，远不止其所消耗的算力。 它可能会让一个失败的方法在剩余运行过程中持续执行，或者丢弃智能体已经找到的正确答案（Brown 等，2024）。 现有的智能体通常将这些决策与对象层面的工作交织进行，在每个步骤中根据累积的历史信息做出一次控制决策（Yao 等，2023b；Shinn 等，2023；Shen 等，2023；Packer 等，2023；Zhang 等，2025a）。 在本文中，我们认为这些决策值得拥有一个独立的智能体推理过程。 智能体可以在做出最终决定前进行审慎思考与查询，例如重读早期的结果，或请求执行单元对某个结果进行验证。 这种审慎思考本身具有特定的结构：它整合了运行过程中已确立的内容，探索可能的后续步骤，并评估每个选项的价值。

paragraphs.en: We call this approach agentic meta-reasoning : the agent reasons about and acts on its own inference process. We implement it as a new inference-time harness , the runtime that coordinates model calls and manages the run. Our Meta-Reasoning Agent separates the workers, which do the task-level work, from the controller, which decides what work to assign. The controller keeps a compact assessment of progress. Full worker outputs remain in persistent memory, where they can be retrieved when needed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种方法称为“智能体元推理”：智能体会对其自身的推理过程进行推理并据此采取行动。 我们将其实现为一种新的推理时执行框架，即负责协调模型调用和管理运行流程的运行时环境。 我们的“元推理智能体”将执行任务级工作的“工作者”与决定分配何种任务的“控制器”分离开来。 控制器会持续对进展情况进行简要评估。 所有工作者的输出结果都会保留在持久化存储中，以便在需要时随时调取。

paragraphs.en: Each control cycle runs four stages: the controller updates the state based on what has changed, proposes next computations, evaluates their value under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work along with the earlier outputs each worker should see. Each of these stages is a full agentic process, with its own instructions and tools. The controller model calls are charged against the same budget as the workers’, so the extra deliberation has to earn what it costs. We record the resulting work as an artifact graph . Every stored output is an artifact, and an edge marks one artifact being supplied as context for producing another. The graph shows where a run branches and which later steps build on earlier ones, letting us diagnose it by the work it produced rather than by its final score alone.
paragraphs.zh: 每个控制周期都运行四个阶段：控制器根据已发生的变化更新状态，提出后续计算步骤，在剩余预算内评估这些步骤的价值，然后将选定的任务与每个工作者应看到的先前输出一起分发出去。 这些阶段中的每一个都是一个完整的智能体过程，拥有自己的指令和工具。 控制器模型的调用会从与工作者相同的预算中扣除费用，因此额外的决策过程必须证明其成本是合理的。 我们将最终产生的工作记录为一个产物图。 每个存储的输出都是一个产物，而一条边则表示一个产物被用作生成另一个产物的上下文。 该图展示了运行过程中的分支点以及后续步骤如何基于早期步骤构建，使我们能够根据它所产生的工作而非仅凭最终分数来诊断其过程。

paragraphs.en: At the main allowances of 100 model calls on the reasoning benchmarks and 1200 on ProgramBench, meta-reasoning yields higher point estimates in all 12 matched comparisons, with mean gains of 3.6–4.2 score points by benchmark. On ProgramBench with GPT-5.5, mean per-problem test-pass rate rises to 71.5% as compared to 58.0% for Codex and 63.7% for direct control. The performance keeps improving as the allowance grows where direct control plateaus, and the artifact graphs show more reuse of earlier work and a correct candidate present in more runs. These results indicate that agentic meta-reasoning, with explicit separation of control and object-level work, leads to agents that scale better as the task length and complexity grow.

paragraphs.en: Inference-time methods allocate computation along a single reasoning path, across independent samples followed by selection, through repeated critique and revision, or over a predefined search structure ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023a ; Besta et al., 2024 ) . These established inference-time computation as a major scaling lever, but they fix the structure of the computation, the number of samples, branches, refinement rounds, verifier calls, or aggregation steps, before the problem reveals what kind of work it needs. Agentic harnesses instead use the model’s own judgments to direct next computations, interleaving reasoning with environment actions, feeding back on earlier attempts, delegating subtasks to specialist models, or decomposing a task into a plan before execution ( Yao et al., 2023b ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Shen et al., 2023 ; Prasad et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) , and modern coding agents extend this to long-running software tasks with file inspection, editing, and command execution ( Anthropic, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025 ) . However, as a task produces more intermediate artifacts, the context these agents act from grows noisier ( Bertsch et al., 2025 ) , which in turn affects their control decisions. This motivates our view of agentic inference as online artifact-graph construction, where the controller reads the graph to direct work and workers extend it.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时的方法将计算分配在单一的推理路径上，跨越独立的样本后进行选择，通过反复的批评与修订，或沿着预定义的搜索结构进行（Wei et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023a ; Besta et al., 2024）。 这些成熟的推理时方法将计算视为主要的扩展手段，但它们在问题尚未揭示所需工作类型之前，就已固定了计算结构、样本数量、分支、优化轮数、验证器调用或聚合步骤。 智能体驱动的方法则利用模型自身的判断来指导后续计算，将推理与环境交互交替进行，对早期尝试进行反馈，将子任务委托给专业模型，或在执行前将任务分解为计划（Yao et al., 2023b ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Shen et al., 2023 ; Prasad et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024），而现代编码智能体则将其扩展至长期运行的软件任务，包括文件检查、编辑和命令执行（Anthropic, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025）。 然而，随着任务产生更多中间产物，这些智能体所依据的上下文会变得越来越嘈杂（Bertsch et al., 2025），进而影响它们的控制决策。 这促使我们将智能体推理视为在线构建产物图的过程：控制器通过读取该图来指导工作，而执行者则不断扩展该图。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work learns, searches, or optimizes the system that coordinates model calls. GPTSwarm learns communication structures among agents ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) ; AgentOrchestra and related systems study multi-agent coordination ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) ; Meta-Harness and Fugu optimize or train harnesses and orchestrator models for stronger task performance ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Sakana AI Fugu Team et al., 2026 ) ; Conductor and Trinity similarly treat orchestration as a first-class object of system design ( Nielsen et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . More recent work automates harness construction directly, synthesizing, evolving, or learning to edit it from execution feedback and failure trajectories ( Lou et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2026 ) ; Ren et al. (2026) survey the area. Whether such automation improves on simpler test-time scaling is under active investigation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Rather than training a new orchestrator or searching over a task-specific harness, we isolate the control mechanism and structure it as its own agentic process.

paragraphs.en: The metacognition literature gives a more precise vocabulary for this control problem: an intelligent system must monitor the state of its own computation and use that monitoring to regulate what it does next ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Work operationalizing this for language models casts inference as a budgeted value-of-computation problem, turns self-monitoring signals such as feeling-of-knowing or judgment-of-learning into trust and retry decisions, separates object-level reasoning from meta-level regulation, adds an explicit monitoring stage to generate-verify pipelines, and uses metacognitive signals to decide when to invoke tools or stop reasoning ( De Sabbata et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2025 ; Oh and Gobet, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) . Our setting differs in the object being controlled: not a single chain, tool trigger, or stopping rule, but a growing external computation over persistent artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 元认知领域的文献为这一控制问题提供了更精确的术语：一个智能系统必须监控自身计算的状态，并利用这种监控来调节其后续行为（Liu et al., 2026）。 将这一理念应用于语言模型的研究中，推理被视作一个受预算限制的计算价值问题；自我监控信号（如“熟悉感”或“学习判断”）被转化为信任与重试决策；对象层面的推理与元层面的调控被分离开来；生成-验证流程中加入了明确的监控阶段；并通过元认知信号来决定何时调用工具或停止推理（De Sabbata et al., 2024; Zhao et al., 2026a; Cao et al., 2026; Dong et al., 2025; Oh and Gobet, 2025; Li et al., 2025; Xiang et al., 2026）。 我们的设定在控制对象上有所不同：所控制的并非单一推理链、工具触发机制或停止规则，而是一个基于持久化产物不断扩展的外部计算过程。

paragraphs.en: Long-running agents also require mechanisms for preserving and selecting information. MemGPT treats memory management as part of the language-model system ( Packer et al., 2023 ) ; A-MEM, Mem0, and ACE develop adaptive or persistent memory interfaces for agents ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) ; CoALA frames agents as systems with structured memory, action, and decision components ( Sumers et al., 2024 ) . The Recursive Language Model (RLM) holds the context in a variable the model edits with code rather than in a transcript ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . PRO-LONG keeps a complete interaction log and searches it programmatically ( Fox et al., 2026 ) . In our setting memory is an action surface for controlling inference, since the controller writes artifacts, reads selected prior work, and chooses what context each worker sees, determining what later computation can build on.

paragraphs.en: Several recent works move beyond final accuracy by asking where performance comes from. Large Language Monkeys separates generating a correct candidate from selecting it ( Brown et al., 2024 ) ; Other work studies the structure of generated candidate sets and search traces ( Saad-Falcon et al., 2025 ; Dragoi et al., 2026 ) ; AgentEval, MAST, and Who & When provide evaluation frameworks or taxonomies for agent failures ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) ; recent work further localizes agent failures to components, interactions, and points in a trajectory ( Raj et al., 2026 ; Shah et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) . We build on this diagnostic line, but tie it directly to the artifact graph induced by a run. The graph lets us measure compute use, topology, coverage, monitoring, and selection in one object.

sents.en: The graph lets us measure compute use, topology, coverage, monitoring, and selection in one object.

paragraphs.en: Agentic meta-reasoning treats the choice of what to compute next as its own agentic reasoning task, separate from the object-level computation it directs. This disentangles the two cognitive functions of an agent while letting work accumulate without conditioning every control decision on its history.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体元推理将接下来计算什么的选择视为其自身的智能体推理任务，这与它指导的对象级计算是分离的。 这种分离使智能体的两种认知功能得以解耦，同时允许工作逐步积累，而无需将每个控制决策都与其历史相关联。

paragraphs.en: Each control cycle has four sequential stages: Assess , Propose , Evaluate , and Dispatch . Each stage is an agentic process with its own prompts, context, and permitted memory operations and tools. A single stage can incorporate its own investigative actions and deliberation, so it may take several model calls to resolve. Between cycles, only a compact state is persisted and each stage may retrieve prior artifacts as needed. Memory and budget can change within a cycle as stages read, write, and consume model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 每个控制周期包含四个顺序阶段：评估、提议、评价和派遣。 每个阶段都是一个智能体过程，拥有自己的提示词、上下文以及允许的记忆操作和工具。 单个阶段可以包含自身的调查行动和审议过程，因此可能需要多次模型调用才能完成。 周期之间仅保留一个紧凑的状态，且每个阶段可根据需要检索先前的产物。 在周期内，随着各阶段读取、写入和消耗模型调用，记忆和预算可能会发生变化。

paragraphs.en: A run can spend its calls on independent attempts, or on building on, checking, and repairing earlier ones. The artifact graph distinguishes these patterns. Its nodes are worker outputs; its edges record which earlier outputs were supplied as context. We count nodes and edges to measure the amount of work and its recorded dependencies. Roots have no incoming edges; descendants have at least one. Fan-in counts a node’s incoming edges, and we report its mean and maximum across nodes. Depth measures the longest dependency path in edges, with roots at depth zero. Width is the largest number of nodes at the same depth.

paragraphs.en: These diagnostics turn one final score into a more useful account of the run. They show what computation occurred, whether it produced correct work, and whether that work reached the final answer. The split also points at different remedies, since a coverage-bound failure motivates changes to exploration or object-level problem solving, while a selection-bound failure motivates tests of assessment, verification, and commitment.
paragraphs.zh: 这些诊断方法能将一个最终得分转化为对运行过程更有益的说明。 它们展示了发生了哪些计算、计算是否产生了正确的成果，以及这些成果是否得出了最终答案。 这种划分也指向了不同的解决方案：受覆盖限制失败需要调整探索或对象层问题解决方法，而受选择限制失败则需要对评估、验证和决策进行检验。

paragraphs.en: We study whether agentic meta-reasoning improves final performance, whether its benefit grows with the available budget, and how it changes the work done during a run. We evaluate two different settings. On IMO ProofBench-Advanced, ARC-AGI-2, and LongCoT-mini, which we refer to together as the reasoning benchmarks, each worker is a model call that returns a text artifact and uses no external tools. On ProgramBench, each worker is a coding agent that can inspect files, run commands, and test a reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: LongCoT ( Motwani et al., 2026 ) contains long-horizon reasoning problems across logic, computer science, chemistry, chess, and mathematics; we evaluate its 507-problem mini split. paragraphs.en: On the reasoning benchmarks, we also evaluate RLM ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . It places the task in a variable inside a Python interpreter rather than in the conversation. Each turn, the model writes code that calls a sub-model over part of that task, reads the printed result, and continues. A call can also spawn a child instance with its own turns, which is where the recursion arises. The agent has neither our worker-dispatch tool nor our artifact memory; its context is a single blob it edits with code. We make two modifications to the canonical design for comparability (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 在推理基准测试中，我们还评估了 RLM（Zhang 等人，2025a）。 它将任务置于 Python 解释器中的一个变量内，而不是放在对话中。 在每个回合中，模型会编写代码来对任务的一部分调用子模型，读取打印出的结果，然后继续执行。 一次调用也可以生成一个拥有自己回合的子实例，递归性正是由此产生的。 该智能体既没有我们的工作者调度工具，也没有我们的工件记忆；其上下文是一个由代码编辑的单一数据块。 为了便于比较，我们对标准设计进行了两项修改（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: On ProgramBench we also compare against three complete coding agents: mini-SWE Agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , and Codex ( OpenAI, 2025 ) . paragraphs.zh: 在 ProgramBench 中，我们还与三种完整的编码智能体进行了比较：mini-SWE Agent（Yang 等人，2024）、Claude Code（Anthropic，2026）和 Codex（OpenAI，2025）。 我们在我们的工作者使用的相同容器环境中（附录 I），对 mini-SWE Agent 与所有三种模型进行了测试，并对 Codex 和 Claude Code 与其原生模型 GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.8 进行了测试。

paragraphs.en: We use Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5, and Opus 4.8 as the underlying models for all systems and benchmarks. The reasoning benchmarks use nominal budgets of 25, 50, and 100 model calls per problem. ProgramBench uses 400, 800, and 1200 calls, as a coding worker can make many calls during a single assignment. The main comparison uses the largest allowance in each setting: 100 calls for reasoning and 1200 for ProgramBench. External baselines receive the same nominal allowance for the comparison being reported.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.8 作为所有系统和基准测试的基础模型。 推理基准测试为每个问题设定了名义上的模型调用预算，分别为 25、50 和 100 次。 ProgramBench 使用 400、800 和 1200 次调用，因为编码工作者在一次任务中可能会进行多次调用。 主要对比使用了每种设置下的最大允许调用次数：推理为 100 次，ProgramBench 为 1200 次。 在报告的对比较中，外部基线模型也获得了相同的名义调用配额。

sents.zh: 在报告的对比较中，外部基线模型也获得了相同的名义调用配额。

paragraphs.en: We count every controller and worker model call toward the same budget. This includes all calls within controller stages and coding workers. Calls from parallel workers are summed, not counted as a single batch. Every system we evaluate is told how much of its allowance it has consumed and how much remains, and every one can stop early, so the calls a system actually uses may fall well short of its nominal allowance. The external baselines have no native notion of a model-call budget, so we add the same accounting to each (Appendices H and I ). If an agent exhausts it without stopping, the run is forced to submit an available solution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个控制器和工作者模型调用都计入同一预算。 这包括控制器阶段和编码工作者内的所有调用。 并行工作者的调用会被累加，而不是计为单个批次。 我们评估的每个系统都会被告知其配额已消耗多少以及剩余多少，并且每个系统都可以提前停止，因此一个系统实际使用的调用可能远低于其名义配额。 外部基线没有内置的模型调用预算概念，因此我们为每个基线添加了相同的会计机制（附录 H 和 I）。 如果某个智能体在耗尽配额后未停止，运行将被强制提交一个可用的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: We report final performance using each benchmark’s own metric, as defined in Section 5.1 . Budget sweeps show whether a larger allowance leads to better results.

paragraphs.en: To examine the work behind the scores, we use the diagnostics in Section 4 . We measure model calls used, artifact-graph structure, memory operations, and controller context. For the Meta-Reasoning Agent, we also report volume of memory operations by stage.

paragraphs.en: At the main budget settings, the Meta-Reasoning Agent scores highest in every model and benchmark pairing (Table 1 , Figure 2 ). On IMO ProofBench-Advanced it improves by 4.0 points on average across the three models, with the largest gain, 8.6 points, coming with Gemini 3.1 Pro. ARC-AGI-2 improves by 4.2 points and is the most consistent, every model gaining between 2.5 and 6.7. LongCoT-mini improves by 3.6 points but has the highest spread, from 0.4 points with GPT-5.5 to 9.2 with Gemini 3.1 Pro, the largest single gain over direct control.
paragraphs.zh: 在主预算设置中，Meta-Reasoning Agent 在所有模型与基准测试的组合中都获得了最高分数（表 1，图 2）。 在 IMO ProofBench-Advanced 上，它在三种模型中的平均提升为 4.0 分，其中最大的提升为 8.6 分，出现在 Gemini 3.1 Pro 中。 ARC-AGI-2 提升了 4.2 分，并且表现最为稳定，所有模型的提升都在 2.5 到 6.7 分之间。 LongCoT-mini 提升了 3.6 分，但其提升幅度差异最大，从 GPT-5.5 的 0.4 分到 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 9.2 分，这是相对于直接控制最大的单次提升。

paragraphs.en: Meta-reasoning also achieves higher scores than the external systems evaluated in each setting (Figure 2 ). On ProgramBench with GPT-5.5, it reaches 71.5%, compared with 58.0% for Codex. With Opus 4.8, it achieves 67.2%, compared with 65.5% for Claude Code. It also exceeds mini-SWE Agent with all three models, by 2.5–13.9 points. These comparisons provide end-to-end reference points against established systems, while the matched Direct Control comparison more directly tests the effect of changing how agentic computation is controlled.
paragraphs.zh: 元推理在每个设置中取得的分数也高于所评估的外部系统（图2）。 在 ProgramBench 上，使用 GPT-5.5 时，其准确率达到 71.5%，而 Codex 为 58.0%。 使用 Opus 4.8 时，其准确率达到 67.2%，而 Claude Code 为 65.5%。 在所有三种模型中，它也比 mini-SWE Agent 高出 2.5–13.9 分。 这些比较为与成熟系统的端到端参考提供了基准，而匹配的“直接控制”比较则更直接地检验了改变智能体计算控制方式所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: A larger allowance helps only if the agent finds useful ways to spend it. Figure 3 shows that meta-reasoning generally uses more calls as its budget grows. Direct control often stops early. On ProgramBench with GPT-5.5, it uses only about 18% of the 1200-call allowance. Across models, meta-reasoning uses roughly 89% to 101% at this setting. The budget is enforced between control cycles, so workers dispatched while the run is still under the cap go to completion and can carry the total slightly past the allowance.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当智能体找到有用的花费方式时，更大的额度才会有帮助。 图3显示，随着预算增加，元推理通常会使用更多的调用次数。 直接控制通常会提前停止。 在 ProgramBench 上使用 GPT-5.5 时，它仅使用了 1200 次调用额度中的约 18%。 在不同模型中，在此设置下，元推理使用的调用次数约为总额度的 89% 到 101%。 预算是在控制周期之间强制执行的，因此在执行仍在限额内时派出的工作者会完成其任务，并可能使总调用次数略微超出额度。

sents.zh: 预算是在控制周期之间强制执行的，因此在执行仍在限额内时派出的工作者会完成其任务，并可能使总调用次数略微超出额度。

paragraphs.en: The longer runs also produce better answers. As the ProgramBench allowance grows from 400 to 1200 calls, meta-reasoning with GPT-5.5 rises from 64.1% to 71.5%. The aggregate reasoning curves show the same contrast, with meta-reasoning continuing to improve over the tested range while direct control more often plateaus.

paragraphs.en: Meta-reasoning produces more worker outputs than direct control on all three reasoning benchmarks at the main budget, and the reuse between them grow faster still. For instance, on IMO ProofBench-Advanced with Gemini 3.1 Pro, worker artifacts roughly double while recorded dependencies rise by an order of magnitude. Both agents select which earlier artifacts each worker receives through the same interface, so direct control could build the same graph but largely does not.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有三种推理基准测试的主要预算下，元推理产生的智能体输出比直接控制更多，且两者之间的重复利用程度增长得更快。 例如，在 Gemini 3.1 Pro 参与的 IMO ProofBench-Advanced 测试中，智能体的产物数量大致翻倍，而记录到的依赖关系则增加了一个数量级。 两个智能体都通过相同的接口选择每个智能体应接收哪些早期产物，因此直接控制本可以构建出相同的图结构，但实际上却基本没有做到。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows these structural differences on matched problems from each benchmark. It combines exploration and reuse within the same run.

paragraphs.en: Meta-reasoning improves coverage in most evaluated settings (Figure 6 (a)). The largest gains occur with Gemini 3.1 Pro: 20 percentage points on IMO ProofBench-Advanced and 10 on LongCoT-mini. ARC-AGI-2 improves across models, while Opus 4.8 on LongCoT-mini is approximately tied. These gains mean that more runs contain a correct candidate, whether or not it is submitted as the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 元推理在大多数评估设置中提升了覆盖范围（图 6 (a)）。 最大的提升出现在 Gemini 3.1 Pro 上：在 IMO ProofBench-Advanced 上提升了 20 个百分点，在 LongCoT-mini 上提升了 10 个百分点。 ARC-AGI-2 在所有模型上的表现均有提升，而 Opus 4.8 在 LongCoT-mini 上的表现则大致持平。 这些提升意味着更多次运行会包含正确的候选答案，无论该答案是否被提交为最终答案。

paragraphs.en: Worker confidence can be a weak guide to correctness. For Gemini 3.1 Pro on IMO ProofBench-Advanced, its ranking is near chance, with a Type-2 AUC of 0.55. The controller’s verdict reaches 0.88 (Figure 6 (b)). Gemini 3.1 Pro on ARC-AGI-2 shows a similarly large gap. The difference is smaller with GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8, and nearly absent for GPT-5.5 on LongCoT-mini. Explicit controller-level assessment therefore gives a stronger ranking signal than worker confidence in several settings. Whether that signal reaches the final answer is the next question.
paragraphs.zh: 执行者的信心可能无法准确反映正确性。 在 IMO ProofBench-Advanced 测试中，Gemini 3.1 Pro 的排名接近随机水平，其类型 2 AUC 为 0.55。 控制器的判定结果达到了 0.88（图 6 (b)）。 Gemini 3.1 Pro 在 ARC-AGI-2 测试中也表现出同样巨大的差距。 GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.8 的差异较小，而在 LongCoT-mini 测试中，GPT-5.5 几乎不存在这种差异。 因此，在多种情况下，明确的控制器级评估比执行者的信心能提供更强的排名信号。 但这种信号是否最终会体现在答案中，则是下一个问题。

paragraphs.en: Artifact memory holds worker outputs and the controller’s own notes side by side. We observe that the meta-reasoning controller re-reads its own notes more intensively than worker outputs (Figure 7 ). Among artifacts explicitly retrieved at least once, notes average 4.4 to 9.8 reads on ARC-AGI-2 and LongCoT-mini, against 1.9 to 3.3 for worker artifacts. Many artifacts are never retrieved again, but interestingly the controller revisits a small portion of its own notes repeatedly, using them as recurring organizational references.

paragraphs.en: Memory operations concentrate in assess and propose (Figure 7 (a)). Writes outnumber reads for every model. Assess writes steadily but issues almost no reads, which follows from its inputs: new worker artifacts arrive in its prompt, so an explicit read is a request for older work instead. Propose and evaluate account for nearly all the reads, drawing on what the run has already produced. Memory use also rises sharply across models: Gemini 3.1 Pro uses it lightly, GPT-5.5 more often, and Opus 4.8 writes many notes that are never revisited.
paragraphs.zh: 内存操作主要集中在评估和提议阶段（图 7 (a)）。 在所有模型中，写操作的数量都多于读操作。 评估阶段的写操作稳定进行，但几乎不执行读操作，这与其输入有关：新工作成果会出现在其提示中，因此显式的读操作实际上是在请求更早阶段的工作成果。 提议和评估阶段几乎涵盖了所有读操作，这些操作依赖于运行过程中已经生成的内容。 内存使用量也随着模型的不同而显著增加：Gemini 3.1 Pro 的内存使用较少，GPT-5.5 的使用频率更高，而 Opus 4.8 则会生成大量从未被再次访问的笔记。

paragraphs.en: How well an agent performs on a long task is usually read as a property of the model doing the work. Our comparison holds that model fixed. The Meta-Reasoning Agent and the Direct Control Agent call the same models, dispatch the same workers, and draw on the same allowance, differing only in how the run is directed. We observe that every matched setting improves, and the margin widens as the budget allowance grows. The ability to direct a run is therefore a component of agent performance in its own right, one that can be measured and improved separately from the work being directed.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在长任务中的表现通常被视为执行该任务的模型的一项属性。 我们的比较假设模型是固定的。 Meta-Reasoning Agent 和 Direct Control Agent 调用相同的模型、调度相同的工作者，并使用相同的预算额度，二者的区别仅在于任务执行的指导方式。 我们观察到，在所有匹配的设置中性能均有提升，且随着预算额度的增加，性能差距也在扩大。 因此，指导任务执行的能力本身便是智能体性能的一个组成部分，这一能力可以独立于所指导的任务本身进行衡量与改进。

paragraphs.en: An agent’s meta-level reasoning is usually interleaved with the object-level work, sharing the same call, the same context, and the same accumulating history. What we argue conceptually, and observe empirically, is that this level of cognition can itself be a different kind of work, one that takes multiple steps, dedicated tools, and sub-tasks of its own. Before committing to a next computation, the controller retrieves earlier artifacts, writes notes for itself and returns to a few of them repeatedly, and records judgments on candidates that rank correctness better than the workers’ own confidence does. These are epistemic actions in the sense of Kirsh and Maglio (1994) , moves whose purpose is to change what the agent knows rather than to advance the task directly. The persistent memory participates in that reasoning, holding what the controller deems note-worthy so that later stages can act on it, in the way external scaffolding has been argued to participate in cognition rather than merely record it ( Clark and Chalmers, 1998 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的元层推理通常与对象层任务交织进行，共享相同的调用、上下文和累积的历史记录。 我们从概念上提出并经验上观察到，这种认知层次本身可以成为一种不同类型的任务，它需要多个步骤、专用工具以及其自身的子任务。 在确定下一步计算之前，控制器会检索早期的产物，为自己撰写笔记并反复回顾其中一些内容，同时记录那些正确性排名优于执行者自身信心的候选项的判断。 这些是 Kirsh 和 Maglio（1994）所定义的认识论行动，即其目的旨在改变智能体的知识，而非直接推进任务本身。 持久记忆参与了这种推理过程，它保存了控制器认为值得记录的内容，以便后续阶段能够据此采取行动；正如 Clark 和 Chalmers（1998）所论证的那样，外部脚手架不仅记录认知过程，也参与其中。

paragraphs.en: The four stages we propose are one way to organize that activity. What the results support is the separation of these different functions. Judging a growing body of interconnected work is itself a complex problem, so the meta level needs the same affordances as the object level, somewhere to keep what it has worked out, the ability to go and look before deciding, and more than one step in which to do so.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的四个阶段是组织这项活动的一种方式。 研究结果支持将这些不同功能分离开来的观点。 评估日益增多的相互关联的研究成果本身就是一个复杂的问题，因此元层需要与对象层相同的可用功能：一个可以保存已得出结论的地方、在做出决定前能够查阅资料的能力，以及用于完成这一过程的多于一步的流程。

paragraphs.en: Our proposed staged control costs additional compute. The low-budget crossovers in Figure 3 show that the design is not uniformly preferable to direct control. Additionally, an incorrect controller assessment can also propagate a misleading state or discard good partial work it never re-reads, and compact state is lossy, relying on future memory reads to surface information that becomes important only later.

paragraphs.en: An agent given more inference-time computation faces more choices about what to do with it. We introduced agentic meta-reasoning to make those choices an explicit part of the agent. Across four benchmarks and three frontier models, the Meta-Reasoning Agent improves every matched comparison at the main budget settings and keeps improving over the evaluated budget ranges where direct control often plateaus. Our analysis shows that it spends more of its allowance, composes later work out of earlier results, produces a correct candidate in more runs, and judges its own work more reliably than worker confidence does, while decoupling the size of its state from the length of the run.
paragraphs.zh: 拥有更多推理时间计算能力的智能体，在如何利用这些计算能力方面会面临更多选择。 我们引入了智能体元推理机制，使这些选择成为智能体的一个显性组成部分。 在四个基准测试和三种前沿模型中，Meta-Reasoning Agent 在所有主要预算设置下均优于所有匹配对比，并且在直接控制方法常出现平台期的评估预算范围内持续改进。 我们的分析表明，与工人置信度机制相比，该智能体能够更充分地利用其计算配额，将早期结果整合到后续工作中，在更多运行中生成正确候选解，并更可靠地评估自身工作，同时将其状态规模与运行时长解耦。

paragraphs.en: An agent’s performance therefore depends on how well it decides what work is worth doing, alongside how well it does the work. As runs grow longer, that decision becomes work in its own right.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，智能体的表现取决于它有多好地决定哪些工作值得去做，以及它完成这些工作的能力。 随着运行时间越来越长，这种决策本身也成为了一项工作。

paragraphs.en: The matched comparison between meta-reasoning and direct control changes the compact state, agentic stages, and controller memory access at the same time. It establishes the value of the evaluated design as a whole, but not the necessity of each stage or an independent causal effect. Stage-removal, state-only, and memory-interface ablations would be required to determine which mechanisms matter in which regimes.

paragraphs.en: Model calls are an interpretable budget unit, but can they differ significantly in input and output token length as well as wall-clock time, so we draw no inferences at token or runtime levels. The systems also use choose to use different fractions of the available allowance out of their own judgment. Therefore our results concern performance under common nominal call budgets, and not efficiency, latency, or performance at equal matched cost.
paragraphs.zh: 模型调用是一种可解释的预算单位，但其输入和输出词元长度以及实际运行时间是否存在显著差异尚不确定，因此我们不会在词元或运行时层面做出任何推断。 这些系统也会根据自身判断，选择使用可用配额的不同比例。 因此，我们的研究结果关注的是在常规名义调用预算下的性能表现，而非效率、延迟或在成本相等时的性能。

paragraphs.en: The experiments cover three frontier models and four benchmarks, including a proof set with only 30 problems. Positive point estimates across the main comparisons do not establish significance for every difference or generalization to weaker models, other tasks, or substantially longer horizons. External-agent comparisons apply to the evaluated versions and configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 实验涵盖了三种前沿模型和四个基准测试，其中包括一个仅包含 30 道题的证明集。 主要比较中的正向分数估计值并不能证明所有差异都具有显著性，也无法推广到更弱的模型、其他任务或明显更长的时间范围。 外部智能体的比较适用于所评估的版本和配置。

paragraphs.en: The Meta-Reasoning Agent runs four sequential stages per turn: assess, propose, evaluate, dispatch. Each stage is a separate agentic loop that starts from a fresh context every turn, with its own system prompt and user message as detailed below. The system prompts for the three text benchmarks share one prompt structure, with minor benchmark-specific wording changes. For ProgramBench, the only coding benchmark (whose workers are coding agents in a container), we provide the prompts verbatim.

paragraphs.en: Restricted workspace. The reference implementation gives the model a full Python REPL. We observed that it often solves the task by writing Python rather than decomposing it into sub-calls, which makes the comparison unequal in both directions. The Meta-Reasoning Agent and the Direct Control Agent cannot execute code on the reasoning benchmarks, so the baseline would be solving the task with a capability neither of them has. Work done inside the REPL is also free, since only model calls are counted, so the baseline could do far more than its budget suggests. We first tried requiring every code block to call a sub-model, refusing any block that did not. That produced dummy sub-calls which satisfied the requirement while the model still solved the task inline. We therefore replace the REPL with a workspace that keeps the model’s control over its own context while removing its ability to compute. Submitted code is checked against an abstract syntax tree allowlist before it runs, in a namespace with no builtins beyond the functions we supply.
paragraphs.zh: 受限工作区。 参考实现为模型提供了一个完整的 Python REPL。 我们观察到，该模型通常通过编写 Python 代码来完成任务，而不是将其分解为子调用，这使得双向比较都不公平。 Meta-Reasoning Agent 和 Direct Control Agent 无法在推理基准上执行代码，因此基线方案将使用它们两者都不具备的能力来解决任务。 在 REPL 内部完成的工作也是免费的，因为只计算模型调用，所以基线方案可以完成远超其预算所允许的任务量。 我们首先尝试要求每个代码块都必须调用一个子模型，并拒绝任何未这样做代码块的执行。 这产生了虚假的子调用，既满足了要求，又让模型仍然能够直接完成任务。 因此，我们将 REPL 替换为一个工作区，该工作区保留了模型对其自身上下文的控制，但移除了其计算能力。 提交的代码在运行前会与一个抽象语法树白名单进行比对，且在一个除我们提供的函数外没有其他内置函数的命名空间中执行。

paragraphs.en: The model can still assign variables, index and slice the context, build literals and f-strings, call every public string method, use concatenation, equality, and membership tests, print, and call llm_query , rlm_query , their batched variants, len , and str . Loops, comprehensions, generator expressions, function and class definitions, lambdas, imports, arithmetic and bitwise operators, ordering comparisons, try , with , and match are rejected, each with a message naming the provided functions to use instead. The model therefore retains full control over what enters and leaves its context, while every unit of actual work has to pass through a sub-model call.

paragraphs.en: Budget awareness. The reference implementation has no notion of a model-call budget. We add the same accounting the other agents use, charging every call at any depth against one allowance and injecting the same messages at the same thresholds. A system turn is appended each time another tenth of the allowance is consumed.
paragraphs.zh: 预算意识。 参考实现中并没有模型调用预算的概念。 我们加入了其他智能体使用的相同记账方式：每次调用（无论处于哪一层级）都会从一项配额中扣除费用，并在相同的阈值处注入相同的消息。 每当消耗掉另外十分之一的配额时，就会追加一个系统回合。
